name: Visceral smooth muscle function in gut, urinary and reproductive tracts
rationale: Members cover gastric/intestinal motility, micturition, uterine contraction, erection and insemination, i.e. hollow-organ smooth muscle physiology across three tracts, whereas confusables centre on serotonin/tachykinin receptors, muscle relaxation or enteric nervous system development.

qualifier: sperm motility, capacitation and acrosome reaction
name: Fertilization via sperm motility, capacitation and acrosome reaction
rationale: All members describe sperm-side events leading to egg binding and fusion (motility, capacitation, acrosome reaction, zona penetration, egg activation); confusables instead cover sperm structural assembly or the zygotic/germline epigenetic program and lack the motility members.

name: Epidermal cornification and lipoxygenase-derived skin barrier lipids
rationale: Members combine cornified envelope assembly and keratinocyte development with 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin and linoleate metabolism (ARCI ichthyosis genes) that build the epidermal lipid barrier; keratinocyte-differentiation confusables lack the lipoxygenase arm and the eicosanoid confusable lacks cornification.

name: Gonad development and hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal hormone signalling
rationale: Members span testis/ovary differentiation, follicle growth, ovulation and luteinization driven by gonadotropins, activin, AMH and progesterone, which distinguishes it from confusables about genital tract morphogenesis, sperm function or meiotic/germline chromatin.

qualifier: Rap1 and MAPK linkage in platelets
name: Integrin outside-in signalling via Rap1 and MAPK in platelets
rationale: Members are integrin-coupled signal complexes (p130Cas, GRB2:SOS to MAPK, Rap1) plus integrin/cytoskeletal and platelet-activation modules, whereas confusables cover coagulation, GPCR-driven platelet activation, vitamin K, or ILK/Rho focal adhesion signalling.

qualifier: DNA CpG methylation plus histone lysine methyltransferase complexes
name: DNA CpG methylation and histone lysine methyltransferase complexes
rationale: All members concern DNA or histone-lysine methylation (DNMT/PRC2/MLL-WDR5/KMT2D, imprinting, CpG island silencing); the DNA-methylation and imprinting members distinguish it from confusables focused on arginine methylation, demethylases or CHD/NuRD remodelling.

qualifier: PPAR, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptors
name: White adipogenesis with PPAR, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptors
rationale: Members cover white fat cell differentiation and PPARG/PPARA-driven programs together with PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis and ROR/REV-ERB/BMAL clock regulation, which separate it from brown/beige adipocyte, LXR/SREBP lipogenic and negative-regulation confusables.

core: Regulation of sodium and potassium membrane transport
name: Aldosterone-linked regulation of sodium and potassium membrane transport
rationale: Members regulate Na+ import/export and K+ import across the plasma membrane, including renal sodium transport and aldosterone response, distinguishing it from osmotic-stress, cation-chloride cotransporter and renin-angiotensin confusables.

name: Tricarboxylic acid cycle and iron-sulfur cluster enzyme maturation
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates and steps (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate, SDH to ubiquinone) plus Fe-S cluster assembly and TCA enzyme maturation, which the PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase confusables lack.

name: Presynaptic calcium-driven enhancement of neurotransmitter release
rationale: All members concern presynaptic depolarization and calcium rise boosting vesicle exocytosis and short-term potentiation; confusables cover vesicle priming/fusion machinery, G-protein presynaptic inhibition or inhibitory synapse assembly without the calcium-entry members.

name: Somitogenesis and left-right patterning via extracellular Nodal/BMP sequestration
rationale: Members combine somite specification and axis elongation with Nodal regulation, left-right asymmetry and extracellular sequestration of BMP/ligands; confusables share somitogenesis but add limb, Hox, Notch O-glycosylation or neural plate members instead.

name: Primary cilium trafficking and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members are intraflagellar/BBSome ciliary cargo transport, basal body and transition-zone assembly plus photoreceptor and retinal neuron development, distinguishing it from motile-cilium/axoneme, multiciliogenesis and mitotic centrosome confusables.

name: Growth plate chondrocyte maturation and RUNX2-driven ossification
rationale: Members cover chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy with RUNX2-regulated osteoblast development and endochondral/intramembranous ossification; confusables lack the chondrocyte regulation members or emphasise tendon, joint and articular cartilage.

name: ARF/INK4A-p53-p21 G1 arrest and its cancer-associated defects
rationale: Members are TP53 expression/activity and p21-mediated G1 arrest plus p14ARF and p16INK4A loss-of-function variants that evade senescence, distinguishing it from generic senescence/SASP, p53 apoptosis and RB/CDK4/6 G1-S confusables.

name: Protein lysine acetylation of histones and tubulin
rationale: Members are lysine/internal acetylation, histone acetyltransferases and tubulin deacetylation control (with centriole replication), which separates it from tubulin glutamylation, BAF remodelling, CENP-A deposition and methylation confusables.

name: COPII vesicle cargo loading at ER exit sites
rationale: All members describe COPII coat-mediated cargo concentration and ER-to-Golgi export, distinguishing it from ERAD, SRP targeting, COPI retrograde traffic and vesicle tethering confusables.

name: Inherited urea cycle enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Every member is a disease variant of a urea cycle enzyme (NAGS, CPS1, OTC, ASS1, ASL, ARG1), whereas confusables describe normal arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism and its transcriptional control.

name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning, COPI budding and membrane tubulation, distinguishing it from COPI retrograde/intra-Golgi traffic and Rab/ARF endosomal recycling confusables.

name: Cerebellar Purkinje layer formation and locomotor coordination
rationale: Members are walking, righting reflex and adult locomotion with Purkinje cell layer formation, i.e. cerebellar motor coordination, unlike confusables on hindbrain/brainstem development or exploratory and psychomotor behaviour.

qualifier: lens transparency, cornea and lacrimal gland
name: Lens transparency and anterior ocular tissue development
rationale: Most members concern lens fiber morphogenesis and transparency (gap-junction coupled), cornea and lacrimal gland, separating it from retinal, eye vasculature and inner ear confusables; common bile duct development is an outlier.

name: Base deamination and oxidative demethylation of DNA and RNA
rationale: Members are APOBEC/ADAR deamination editing (including antiviral restriction), TET/TDG demethylation and ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal, distinguishing it from viral replication, base-excision and broad DNA repair confusables.

qualifier: BCR tuning and B cell proliferation
name: B cell receptor signalling tuning and B cell proliferation
rationale: Members are BCR second-messenger signalling, CD22 and positive/negative BCR regulation, B cell proliferation and B-cell expression modules, unlike confusables centred on B cell development, RAS/BTK, or germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation.

qualifier: terminal fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens
name: N-, O-glycan and glycolipid fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens
rationale: Members cover N- and O-glycan elongation and termination, GDP-fucose and sialylation, ABO/Lewis antigens, glycosphingolipids and selectin-dependent leukocyte rolling, distinguishing it from nucleotide-sugar, GAG/O-mannose and sialic acid metabolism confusables.

name: Gamma-glutamyl cycle glutathione synthesis and inherited defects
rationale: Members are glutathione synthesis/recycling and disease variants of GCLC, GSS, GGT1, OPLAH and ACY1, whereas confusables cover cystine/glutathione transport, catabolism, ferroptosis or sulfur amino acid metabolism.

name: CCR2-CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking and chemotaxis restraint
rationale: Members are CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte migration modules, monocyte aggregation and negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, unlike confusables on generic chemokines or positive monocyte recruitment and inflammatory activation.
